## CONSISTENCY: PASS

## Additional Observations (No Issues Found)
- The interface demonstrates excellent adherence to dark mode best practices with sufficient contrast ratios
- Clear visual hierarchy through typography and spacing
- Consistent component styling across modpack cards
- Proper empty state messaging for the "Your Modpacks" section
- Well-organized navigation structure with clear current location indicators
- All interactive elements provide appropriate visual feedback
- Clean, uncluttered layout that follows minimalist design principles

The Minecraft Launcher interface successfully meets WCAG 2.2 AA standards, Nielsen's heuristics, and Laws of UX principles. No accessibility or usability issues were identified in the provided screenshot.
